visual_elements.description: Feedforward/backpropagation diagram. Far left: four small purple input dots fan into three horizontal rows. Each row contains a blue circle labeled Σ, a small white activation box whose glyph looks like ∫ or f, and two small white circles labeled o. From these hidden outputs, diagonal arrows labeled W_ji point into three green circles labeled Net_i. Each green Net_i node connects to a small white activation box and then to a yellow output circle labeled O_i; the top highlighted yellow output is labeled O_j and ringed in red. Arrows from the yellow outputs point to Output 1, Output 2, and Output m. A vertical red strip on the right repeats the word Error three times; to its right are Class 1, Class 2, and Class m. A purple circle labeled 1 with the label Node Bias sits below the hidden layer and arrows upward into the green output-layer nodes. A green downward arrow labeled j marks the output-node index. Callout ∂Net_j/∂w_ji points to a W_ji arrow; callout ∂E/∂Net_j = -δ_j points to the top O_j node.
